description:
What a dry run of a plan would cost, before it runs. Free: nothing is stored or charged.

A dry run reads the sample documents with the plan's task types, applying nothing, and scores what it read against the answer key. The organisation's monthly allowance of free dry-run pages covers samples in order, each whole or not at all; the rest cost credits, priced as a "Try it" sample.

Needs an API key with the 'onboard' scope (#844), which is never on by default: an organisation admin or engineer ticks it on a new key (a key that had 'workflows' before #844 was given it). Without it the call fails naming the scope: ask a person for such a key rather than retrying.

Args:
  - plan_id, expected_revision: the plan, at the revision you read.
  - samples: 1..25 of { document_key (from handinloop_upload_sample_document), source_ref, task_type? }.
  - answer_key: the samples' completed examples, as the pilot ground-truth CSV, at most 1MB.

Returns: { plan_id, plan_revision, samples: [{ source_ref, task_type, pages, free, credits }], free_pages, credits, free_pages_remaining, answer_key_cells, expected_credits, expected_free_pages, next_step }. Run it with the same samples and answer key, and expected_credits and expected_free_pages as quoted.

answer_key.description: The samples' completed examples as the pilot ground-truth CSV (wide or long, rules included): a source_ref column naming each sample, and columns of the plan's task types' fields

source_ref.description: The document's name in the answer key, unique in the run

task_type.description: The plan's task type it runs under; optional when the plan has one

name: handinloop_quote_plan_dry_run
title: Quote a Plan Dry Run
